name: PostGIS
description: Add a PostgreSQL/PostGIS table to the map as a vector layer, read through DuckDB's postgres extension. Needs DuckDB 1.5 or later.
author: Travis Webb

commands.label:
Add PostGIS
Table
commands.help: Add PostgreSQL/PostGIS tables to the map as layers. First fill in the Set PostGIS Source tool (Geoprocessing pane: connection and table), then click this.
commands.params: {"table"?: "schema.table" (without it, the rows of the 'PostGIS Sources' table),"connection"?: "host=… dbname=… user=…" | "postgresql://…" | "service=name" (default: the PG* environment variables), "name"?: layer name (default: the table's), "columns"?: [column names] (default: all), "geometry"?: the geometry column to draw (default: the first), "where"?: DuckDB SQL condition, "limit"?: number of rows, "crs"?: "EPSG:…" for a geometry column without an SRID (default: longitude/latitude), "zoom"?: bool (default true)}

tools.name: Set PostGIS Source
tools.summary: Fill in a PostGIS table to add: connection and table. Then run Add PostGIS Table.
